description: This file defines the ReferencePlaceholder class responsible for extracting and representing references to entities within placeholders in a Java project related to the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes pattern matching, entity identification, and handling of referenced entity details.

classes.name: ReferencePlaceholder
classes.description: Immutable class that encapsulates information extracted from a reference placeholder string, including entity type, entity ID, and a JSON pointer to the referenced field.

classes.name: ReferencedEntityType
classes.description: Enum representing the type of referenced entities, currently only 'THINGS'. Provides method to convert from string with case-insensitivity.

methods.name: fromCharSequence
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence input to extract reference placeholder details if it matches the predefined pattern, returning an Optional containing a ReferencePlaceholder instance.
